blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte is not getting enough for what she is paying her legal team for the impeachment trial if they will present evasive and lying witnesses like the Davao City assessor, prosecution panel spokesperson Robert Ace Barbers said. In a press briefing during a break in Duterte’s trial on Monday, Barbers noted that Davao City Assessor Engr. Jaime Adalin tried to evade the prosecution’s questions during cross-examination and might have brought more harm than good to Duterte’s case. “‘Yong witness ay nagbigay ng incredible testimony — hindi credible, kung hindi incredible testimony.
